kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتشخبط (form IIq)
# نَتَشَخْبَطُ (natašaḵbaṭu) /na.ta.ʃax.ba.tˤu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَشَخْبَطَ (tašaḵbaṭa)
# نَتَشَخْبَطَ (natašaḵbaṭa) /na.ta.ʃax.ba.tˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَشَخْبَطَ (tašaḵbaṭa)
# نَتَشَخْبَطْ (natašaḵbaṭ) /na.ta.ʃax.batˤ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَشَخْبَطَ (tašaḵbaṭa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
